# MCP Tool Catalog

The server exposes 148 MCP tools in 12 categories. This catalog is generated from the YAML frontmatter of the tool docs under `src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/`, the files the server loads into `TOOL_REGISTRY`. Each category page lists its tools' permission, parameters and a link to the tool doc, which holds the full description. Parameter descriptions are the first sentence of the schema description; Permission is the tool's `required_permission`.

## Categories

| Category | Tools | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| [admin](admin.md) | 30 | Administration - manage users, groups, roles, API keys, and server configuration |
| [cicd](cicd.md) | 6 | CI/CD integration - GitHub Actions and GitLab CI workflow status and management |
| [depmap](depmap.md) | 6 | Dependency-map analysis tools for impact assessment across all domains |
| [files](files.md) | 5 | File operations - create, read, edit, and delete files in activated repositories |
| [git](git.md) | 36 | Git operations - explore history, blame, diffs, and perform commits, branches, and pushes |
| [guides](guides.md) | 4 | Meta tools - quick reference, tool discovery, and help documentation |
| [memory](memory.md) | 3 | Shared technical memory store - persistent, evidence-backed facts indexed alongside code. |
| [repos](repos.md) | 27 | Repository management - activate user workspaces, manage golden repositories, and control indexing |
| [scip](scip.md) | 11 | Code intelligence - find definitions, references, dependencies, and call chains using SCIP indexes |
| [search](search.md) | 16 | Semantic and full-text code search across repositories |
| [ssh](ssh.md) | 2 | SSH key management - add, list, and remove SSH keys for git authentication |
| [tracing](tracing.md) | 2 |  |

## depmap

- [`depmap_find_consumers`](depmap.md#depmap_find_consumers) - Find all repos that depend on a given repo across every dependency-map domain.
- [`depmap_get_cross_domain_graph`](depmap.md#depmap_get_cross_domain_graph) - Return all domain-to-domain edges as JSON records (source, target, dependency_count, types); no rendering — pass edges to your visualization tool of choice.

## git

- [`close_pull_request`](git.md#close_pull_request) - Close (without merging) a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request. Auto-detects forge type from the remote URL. Credentials are auto-fetched from stored git credentials.
- [`comment_on_pull_request`](git.md#comment_on_pull_request) - Add a comment to a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request. Supports both general conversation comments and inline review comments attached to a specific file and line.
- [`create_pull_request`](git.md#create_pull_request) - Create a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request from a repository in write mode. Auto-detects forge type (github/gitlab) from the remote URL. Requires write mode to be active.
- [`get_pull_request`](git.md#get_pull_request) - Get full details of a pull request / merge request including description, labels, reviewers, CI status, merge status, and diff statistics.
- [`git_amend`](git.md#git_amend) - Amend the most recent git commit. Can update the commit message or just re-commit staged changes with the existing message. Uses PAT credential identity for author/committer attribution.
- [`git_blame`](git.md#git_blame) - See who wrote each line of a file and when (line-by-line attribution).
- [`git_branch_create`](git.md#git_branch_create) - Create a new git branch at current HEAD.
- [`git_branch_delete`](git.md#git_branch_delete) - Delete a git branch (DESTRUCTIVE).
- [`git_branch_list`](git.md#git_branch_list) - List all branches with current branch indicator.
- [`git_branch_switch`](git.md#git_branch_switch) - Switch to a different branch (git checkout).
- [`git_checkout_file`](git.md#git_checkout_file) - Discard local changes and restore file to HEAD.
- [`git_clean`](git.md#git_clean) - Remove untracked files from working tree (DESTRUCTIVE).
- [`git_commit`](git.md#git_commit) - Create a commit with staged changes.
- [`git_conflict_status`](git.md#git_conflict_status) - Get detailed merge conflict status with conflict marker regions per file.
- [`git_diff`](git.md#git_diff) - Show line-by-line changes between two revisions (commits, branches, tags).
- [`git_fetch`](git.md#git_fetch) - Download remote changes without merging.
- [`git_file_at_revision`](git.md#git_file_at_revision) - View a file's contents as it existed at any commit, branch, or tag.
- [`git_file_history`](git.md#git_file_history) - Get all commits that modified a specific file.
- [`git_log`](git.md#git_log) - Browse commit history with filtering by path, author, date, or branch.
- [`git_mark_resolved`](git.md#git_mark_resolved) - Mark a conflicted file as resolved after editing to remove conflict markers.
- [`git_merge`](git.md#git_merge) - Merge a source branch into the current branch with conflict detection.
- [`git_merge_abort`](git.md#git_merge_abort) - Cancel in-progress merge and restore pre-merge state.
- [`git_pull`](git.md#git_pull) - Fetch and merge changes from remote repository.
- [`git_push`](git.md#git_push) - Push local commits to remote repository using your personal access token. Requires a git credential configured via configure_git_credential. Push uses HTTPS with PAT authentication and sets author/committer from your stored forge identity.
- [`git_reset`](git.md#git_reset) - Reset working tree to specific state (DESTRUCTIVE).
- [`git_search_commits`](git.md#git_search_commits) - Search commit messages for keywords, ticket numbers, or patterns.
- [`git_search_diffs`](git.md#git_search_diffs) - Find when specific code was added/removed in git history (pickaxe search).
- [`git_show_commit`](git.md#git_show_commit) - View detailed info about a single commit (message, stats, diff).
- [`git_stage`](git.md#git_stage) - Stage files for commit (git add).
- [`git_stash`](git.md#git_stash) - Stash and restore uncommitted changes in a git repository. Supports push, pop, apply, list, and drop actions.
- [`git_status`](git.md#git_status) - Get working tree status showing staged/unstaged/untracked files.
- [`git_unstage`](git.md#git_unstage) - Remove files from staging area (git reset HEAD).
- [`list_pull_request_comments`](git.md#list_pull_request_comments) - Read all comments and review notes on a pull request / merge request. Returns both inline review comments and general conversation in unified format.
- [`list_pull_requests`](git.md#list_pull_requests) - List pull requests / merge requests for a repository. Supports filtering by state (open/closed/merged/all) and author. Auto-detects forge type (github/gitlab) from remote URL.
- [`merge_pull_request`](git.md#merge_pull_request) - Merge a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request. Auto-detects forge type from the remote URL. Credentials are auto-fetched from stored git credentials.
- [`update_pull_request`](git.md#update_pull_request) - Update metadata of a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request. Supports updating title, description, labels, assignees, and reviewers. At least one field must be provided.

- [`get_golden_repo_indexes`](repos.md#get_golden_repo_indexes) - Get structured status of all index types for a golden repository.
- [`get_index_status`](repos.md#get_index_status) - Query current index status for all index types in a repository.

- [`list_global_repos`](repos.md#list_global_repos) - List all globally accessible repositories.
- [`list_repo_categories`](repos.md#list_repo_categories) - List all repository categories with their patterns and priorities.

- [`set_global_config`](repos.md#set_global_config) - Configure auto-refresh interval for ALL global repositories system-wide.
- [`switch_branch`](repos.md#switch_branch) - Switch YOUR activated repository to different branch and re-index automatically.
- [`sync_repository`](repos.md#sync_repository) - Synchronize an activated repository with its golden repository source.
- [`trigger_dependency_analysis`](repos.md#trigger_dependency_analysis) - Manually trigger dependency map analysis (full or delta mode).
- [`trigger_reindex`](repos.md#trigger_reindex) - Trigger manual re-indexing for specified index types.

- [`scip_references`](scip.md#scip_references) - [SCIP] Find all places where a symbol is used (imports, calls, instances).

## search

- [`analyze_graph`](search.md#analyze_graph) - Multi-file, whole-repository graph analysis -- builds a real CSR reference graph across every file in the repo, then runs your Rust evaluator's fn analyze_graph over the whole graph. Use for cross-file questions single-file AST search (xray_search) cannot answer: dead code, unreachable/unwired components, layering violations, endpoint-to-sink reachability, blast radius.
- [`browse_directory`](search.md#browse_directory) - List files with metadata (size, language, date) - flat list for filtering.
- [`cidx_fetch_cached_payload`](search.md#cidx_fetch_cached_payload) - Retrieve the full payload for a truncated xray_search, xray_explore, or analyze_graph result using the cache_handle returned when a result was too large to return inline.
- [`directory_tree`](search.md#directory_tree) - Visual ASCII tree of directory structure (like 'tree' command).
- [`get_cached_content`](search.md#get_cached_content) - Retrieve cached content by handle with pagination support.
- [`get_file_content`](search.md#get_file_content) - Read file content with metadata and line-offset pagination to avoid context exhaustion.
- [`list_files`](search.md#list_files) - List all files in a repository with metadata (size, date, language, indexed).
- [`poll_search_job`](search.md#poll_search_job) - Non-blocking check for an async-hybrid temporal search_code job. Returns immediately with partial or final results.
- [`regex_search`](search.md#regex_search) - Direct pattern search on files without index - comprehensive but slower.
- [`search_code`](search.md#search_code) - Search code using pre-built indexes.
- [`store_xray_pattern`](search.md#store_xray_pattern) - Store a reusable Rust xray evaluator pattern in the cidx-meta pattern library. Stored patterns can be referenced by name in xray_search and xray_explore via the pattern_name parameter.
- [`wiki_article_analytics`](search.md#wiki_article_analytics) - Query wiki article view analytics with sort, filter, and search capabilities.
- [`xray_dump_ast`](search.md#xray_dump_ast) - Synchronously dump the complete tree-sitter AST for a single file — no job polling required.
- [`xray_explore`](search.md#xray_explore) - Debug-mode X-Ray search -- same two-phase driver+evaluator as xray_search but enriches every match with a serialised AST tree so you can understand the node structure tree-sitter produces for your code. Evaluator is Rust native code (fn evaluate_node).
- [`xray_search`](search.md#xray_search) - Two-phase AST-aware search -- regex driver narrows candidate files, Rust native evaluator inspects each file's AST and returns a list of findings with pattern name, line number, and code snippet.
- [`xray_search_batch`](search.md#xray_search_batch) - Cross-repo, multi-expression X-Ray sweep -- one background job fans out over N repositories x M scan bundles, returns a single job_id, and produces a unified tagged result.
